instruction: Add promtail config for SNMP monitoring
output:
cat > /etc/promtail/snmp-config.yml << 'EOF'
scrape_configs:
- job_name: snmp
  snmp_sd_configs:
  - targets:
      - 192.168.1.100
    labels:
      job: snmp
EOF

instruction: Add promtail config for gelf input
output:
cat > /etc/promtail/gelf-config.yml << 'EOF'
scrape_configs:
- job_name: gelf
  gelf:
    listen_address: 0.0.0.0:12201
    labels:
      job: gelf
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
scrape_configs:
- job_name: consul
  consul_sd_configs:
  - server: localhost:8500
    services:
      - myapp
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_consul_service]
    target_label: service
  - source_labels: [__meta_consul_node]
    target_label: node
EOF

instruction: Add dns service discovery to promtail
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
scrape_configs:
- job_name: dns
  dns_sd_configs:
  - names:
      - myapp.service.consul
    type: A
    port: 8080
EOF
export HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy:3128; export HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy:3128; promtail -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
    timeout: 30s
EOF

instruction: Configure promtail batch size and wait
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
    batchwait: 1s
    batchsize: 1048576
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
    backoff_config:
      min_period: 100ms
      max_period: 10s
      max_retries: 10
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
    external_labels:
      cluster: production
      datacenter: dc1
EOF

instruction: Add basic auth to promtail client
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://localhost:3100/loki/api/v1/push
    basic_auth:
      username: promtail
      password_file: /etc/promtail/pass.txt
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: https://loki.example.com/loki/api/v1/push
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/promtail/ca.crt
      cert_file: /etc/promtail/client.crt
      key_file: /etc/promtail/client.key
      server_name: loki.example.com
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
  grpc_listen_port: 0
  http_tls_config:
    cert_file: /etc/promtail/server.crt
    key_file: /etc/promtail/server.key
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
limit_config:
  max_streams: 1000
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
positions:
  filename: /var/lib/promtail/positions.yml
  sync_period: 10s
  ignore_invalid_yaml: true
EOF

instruction: Configure promtail to use a different loki address
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
clients:
  - url: http://loki-headless:3100/loki/api/v1/push
EOF

instruction: Set promtail log level to debug
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
server:
  log_level: debug
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
  grpc_listen_port: 0
  profile: true
EOF

instruction: Set max batch size for promtail
output:
cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
client:
  max_batch_size: 2097152
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
client:
  max_retries: 5
EOF

cat >> /etc/promtail/config.yml << 'EOF'
positions:
  filename: /var/lib/promtail/positions.yml
  backup_interval: 5m
EOF

instruction: Enable promtail print of config at startup
output: promtail -config.file=/etc/promtail/config.yml -print-config-stages 2>&1 | head -100
